tokens.name: vellum
tokens.usage: The page itself - the ground of every screen. Grounds for ink, ink-muted, ink-faint and every pigment.

tokens.name: folio
tokens.usage: A leaf laid on the page: panels, cards, dialogs, the activity list. Grounds for ink, ink-muted, ink-faint and every pigment.

tokens.name: vellum-worn
tokens.usage: Rubbed-down wells that something fills: progress tracks, meters, the combat log gutter, inset thumbnails. Grounds for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: vellum-tint
tokens.usage: Alternating ledger rows and the hover state of a row. Grounds for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a milestone, relic or dungeon overlay. Never set text on it directly - put a folio leaf on top.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Oak-gall ink: all body copy, headings and figures on vellum, folio, vellum-worn and vellum-tint. 12:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Second-rank text: units, labels, settled costs, the scribe's plain hand. On vellum, folio, vellum-worn and vellum-tint. 4.8:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Locked-but-legible content: unmet prerequisites, closed paths, unavailable activities. On vellum and folio only. 4.8:1 or better - a locked thing is still read, never dimmed away.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: The scribe's ruling: hairlines between rows and around resting leaves. Decorative - never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: rule-ruled
tokens.usage: Drawn frames and the border of any control at rest, including the nine-slice panel edge. 3.4:1 or better on vellum, folio and vellum-worn in both themes.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Red lead: rubricated headings, chapter marks, damage and loss, boss framing, and anything irreversible. Text on vellum and folio, or a fill under on-vermilion.

tokens.name: on-vermilion
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a vermilion fill. 7.3:1 in day, 5.9:1 in candle.

tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: Ultramarine: knowledge, study, magic, the Academy, and every selection or focus state. Text on vellum and folio, or a fill under on-lapis.

tokens.name: on-lapis
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a lapis fill. 8.2:1 in day, 9.1:1 in candle.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Copper green: growth, gain, an activity that is running, a requirement now met, a forecast. Text on vellum and folio, or a fill under on-verdigris.

tokens.name: on-verdigris
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a verdigris fill. 6.9:1 in day, 8.4:1 in candle.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Earth yellow, the everyday warm tone: time costs, age, coin figures, the guild. Common by design - this is what keeps gold-leaf rare. Text on vellum and folio, or a fill under on-ochre.

tokens.name: on-ochre
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an ochre fill. 5.3:1 in day, 7.3:1 in candle.

tokens.name: gold-leaf
tokens.usage: Applied leaf. A FILL only, never text, always with its gold-edge hairline to carry the boundary, and only on the five illuminated events: milestone reached, new profession, rare relic, dungeon completed, major story beat. If it appears on an ordinary screen, the screen is wrong.

tokens.name: on-gold-leaf
tokens.usage: Ink laid over gold leaf - the same dark brown in both themes, because leaf does not change with the light. 6.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: gold-edge
tokens.usage: The darker outline that makes leaf read as metal rather than yellow paint. One hairline inside every gold-leaf shape. 3:1 or better on vellum and folio.

tokens.name: status-gain
tokens.usage: A figure that rose, a requirement met, an encounter survived. Always carries a plus sign or the check mark - never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-loss
tokens.usage: Damage taken, a requirement missed, a path closed. Always carries a minus sign or the cross - never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-time
tokens.usage: Every month an action will cost or has cost. Always beside the hourglass mark and a figure in months.

tokens.name: focus-ink
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline at 2px offset, and the left marker of a selected row. 7:1 or better on vellum, folio and vellum-worn.

tokens.name: state-locked
tokens.usage: Text of a locked activity, path or slot, beside its stated prerequisite.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: The groove of any progress bar, meter or clock.

tokens.name: progress-ink
tokens.usage: The quill filling a progress groove: months spent, the current activity's share, a stat's present value.

tokens.name: progress-forecast
tokens.usage: Hatched at 45 degrees ahead of progress-ink: what the current activity will reach if it runs to term.

styles.name: versal
styles.usage: Fallback size and metrics for a decorative initial. The drawn initial replaces it; this style keeps the layout identical if the asset is missing.

styles.name: chapter
styles.usage: Milestone, end-of-life and relic-discovery openings. One per screen, and only on illuminated screens.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, zone headers, boss headers.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab labels along the top of a page. Display face at a working size; the active tab carries the vermilion underline, not a weight change.

styles.name: gloss-title
styles.usage: The title line of a tooltip gloss: the display face at reading size, one step above the figures it introduces.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Descriptions, chronicle prose, dialogue. EB Garamond runs small - 16px is the floor, not a choice.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Row text in dense lists, combat log lines, tooltip prose.

styles.name: gloss
styles.sample: he had not the strength for it
styles.usage: Marginal annotations: the scribe's aside in the margin, never load-bearing information.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and control labels. Set in caps, at most three words.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Axis ticks, age numerals, footnotes on a frame.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: The label of a control: button faces, the running activity's cost, anything the player clicks. One step under body so a row of controls reads quieter than the prose beside it.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about: current age, boss damage, years lived. Always tabular lining figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Stat values, costs, requirement figures. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums so a rising value never reflows its row.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Figures inside dense text: the values in a tooltip's rows, secondary figures in a ledger. Tabular lining, like every figure.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Deltas and month counts inline in a line of text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its figure.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; padding of a small control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in a ledger list; gap between stacked meters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard leaf padding and the gap between leaves.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of a panel holding leaves; gap under a heading.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between regions of a screen; the text column's inner margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margin - the manuscript's outer margin, where marginalia live.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Ruled frames, panels and leaves. A manuscript page has square corners: this is the default for anything with a drawn border.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Progress fills, tags, small inset wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs. Never more - rounded corners are what makes a fantasy UI look like a phone game.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Genuinely round things only: the seal, the age disc, a portrait roundel.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Ruling between rows, resting leaf edges.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Control borders, selected row marker, focus outline.

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: Drawn frames: portraits, relics, milestone leaves. The outer stroke of a nine-slice.

tokens.name: shadow-leaf
tokens.usage: A leaf resting on the page. Paper on paper - keep it this faint, and use it sparingly; the drawn rule does the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for something lifted off the page: an overlay, a relic revealed, the milestone spread.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Inside a vellum-worn groove so a fill reads as sitting in the page rather than on it.

tokens.name: opacity-locked
tokens.usage: A locked activity's illustration and mark. The text stays at full ink-faint - only the picture dims.

tokens.name: opacity-hatch
tokens.usage: Strength of the 45-degree hatch that marks forecast, not-yet-spent time.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: Watermark drawings under a panel: the zone sketch behind a combat log, the profession mark behind a chronicle entry.
